The teammate owns keyframe extraction and de-identification internals; do not modify those internals and do not add pass-through/fake de-identification. - Cover exactly-eight enforcement, malformed responses, timeout/transient retry behavior, no call on de-identification failure, mock compatibility, and no secret/image-byte leakage.
- Run the focused VLM test suite and report exact commands and results.

Likely files: ai/vlm_sdk.py, scripts/process_vlm.py, ai/vlm/contracts.py only if needed, and VLM tests under tests/.
